description: This file is a JavaScript module configuring and exporting an API client using Axios for a React frontend. It manages API base URLs based on environment variables, provides utility functions for authentication token management, and defines functions for interacting with various backend endpoints such as user, session, and deployment management.

methods.name: inferBackendBase
methods.description: Infers the backend base URL based on the environment and current window location, avoiding mixed content issues.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and concatenates the base URL and path, avoiding duplicate slashes.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from localStorage.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores or removes the authentication token in localStorage.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Stores or removes the user profile in localStorage.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user profile from localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeListResponse
methods.description: Normalizes the backend list API response into a consistent object with items and total count.

methods.name: withStringifiedFilter(params = {})
methods.description: Ensures that the filter parameter is JSON stringified if it's an object.
